messages:
Ava (Palmera): Hey team — heads up, our Localization squad is starting a pilot for localized product descriptions (ES/FR) next week. We'll be hitting new endpoints and I expect ~3x current write QPS. Need guidance on capacity + rollout.

Maya (CSM): Thanks Ava! Can you DM expected peak qps, avg tokens/request, and whether responses are streaming? We can spin up a short pilot pool if needed. cc @Ethan :wave:

Ethan (Solutions): tagging in. If it's ~3x and mostly short requests (<=200 tokens) we can probably reuse the same model with prefix caching + tuned batching, but want exact numbers. Any PII or compliance flags?

Ava (Palmera): No PII — product copy only. Avg ~120 tokens. Mostly synchronous calls, a handful of streaming responses for live-progress UI. Peak windows could reach ~1800 rps cluster-wide during collection pushes.

Maya (CSM): Got it — creating CS ticket and booking an enablement session. Jordan, can infra weigh Dedicated pilot vs hosted burst capacity for that peak?

Jordan (Eng-Infra): On it. Quick Q: which model are they testing? If they go for a 70B-class model with large KV cache patterns, Dedicated is usually safer. For 13B-ish models hosted with burst may be fine. Also need to know expected token/sec per host.

Ava (Palmera): Starting with redwood-clarity-13b for pilot, but plan to test 70b for quality after. Timeline: pilot 2026-04-01 -> 2026-04-15, then if good roll to 3 more squads by 2026-05-01.

Ethan (Solutions): Recommendation: start hosted + short Dedicated reserve during pilot windows. Monitor token-cost delta and p95 latency. Draft autoscale snippet below we can apply to the pilot route:
```
auto_scale:
  min_hosts: 2
  max_hosts: 8
  target_latency_ms: 120
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  prefer_prefix_cache: true
```

Maya (CSM): Enablement booked: Wed 2026-03-27 10:30 PT. I'll invite Palmera engineers and PMs. I'm tagging this in our expansion tracker as an "expansion-signal". :spiral_calendar: 

autoscale-bot: ticket #CS-4531 created for Palmera localization pilot and assigned to Eng-Infra.

Jordan (Eng-Infra): Follow-up — we'll add a fallback policy: auto-fallback from 70B -> 13B with a quality degradation notice if 70B capacity unavailable. Can product accept degraded outputs during fallback?

Ava (Palmera): That's acceptable for the pilot. We'll also upload a sample prompt set and a few golden responses so you can tune eval thresholds.

Maya (CSM): Perfect — please drop the prompts in the Palmera customer folder (shared drive link in DM). We'll wire those into regression alerts and quality monitors. Also flagging renewal cadence: their annual renewal is Q3 — increased healthy usage helps, but we'll watch cost delta vs. forecast and call out if it looks like a risk.

Ava (Palmera): No renewal concerns at the moment. The pilot is to validate EU marketplace UX. Appreciate the quick responses — thanks everyone! :pray:
